description.value:
Once between long rests, you may cast improved battle meditation at its base level without paying force points, and while you sustain concentration on it, its die grows one step at the start of each of your turns (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, or d10 to d12).

Additionally, once per round, when a creature rolls a bonus or penalty die generated by an effect of yours, you may force it to roll that die with advantage or disadvantage, your choice.
